hero.label: 2002 Legendary Collection Gastly Reverse Foil, #76 of 110, PSA 10. Seller received.

notes: Legendary Collection (2002) was the first English set to put a reverse holo on every card, and its starburst foil appears in no other set.
That foil scratches and whitens easily, so a PSA 10 is scarce even on a common Gastly.
Collector Crypt insured this copy at $13,800 when it was tokenized. The only other tokenized copy, a CGC 8.5, is insured at $130.
